proceedings.deciding_body: Slovenj Gradec District Public Prosecutor’s Office
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 17 January 1997 the Public Prosecutor issued a decision dismissing the applicant’s criminal complaint.
By a judgment of 22 November 1999 the court acquitted the applicant.
on 27 September 2000 the Maribor Higher Court quashed the judgment and remitted the case to a new panel for retrial.
By a judgment of 12 February 2001, the Slovenj Gradec District Court convicted the applicant as charged
On 9 May 2001 the Maribor Higher Court upheld the conviction
